تقتحموا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَحِمُوا (taqtaḥimū) /taq.ta.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# تُقْتَحَمُوا (tuqtaḥamū) /tuq.ta.ħa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
